definition: Monitoring and tracing how language models behave in production — prompts, outputs, latency, token use, cost and failures.
details: Observability tooling records every request and response, scores quality and safety, and traces multi-step agent or RAG pipelines to find where errors creep in. It is application monitoring re-imagined for non-deterministic, generative systems.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. In plain words: Monitoring and tracing how language models behave in production — prompts, outputs, latency, token use, cost and failures. Here is how it actually plays out: Observability tooling records every request and response, scores quality and safety, and traces multi-step agent or RAG pipelines to find where errors creep in. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is LLM Observability.
